rule_text: The scaffold-status table classifies every module under src/pkg/ (excluding __init__.py).
notes: Issue #291 — the predicate ranges over the src/pkg/ tree, which is NOT part of the rendered documentation target. The rubric cannot ground a completeness verdict from the doc alone; it must decline with unsupported_reason=cross_artifact_predicate rather than fabricating a pass/fail. Remedy for the rule author is params.target_scope / multi-target (docs/design/multi-target.md §9).
